post.description:
UC-B3 step 6: the member opened a shown result. 404 for someone else's search or an item
that was not shown.

AppealDecidedOut.title: AppealDecidedOut
AppealDecidedOut.description: The new decision; `flagged_outcomes` counts the loan outcomes now under re-evaluation.

AttachmentOut.title: AttachmentOut
AttachmentOut.description: A stored photo. `url` is a short-lived signed link, never a public address.

CaseOut.title: CaseOut
CaseOut.description: An escalation case. The raiser is given by role only, never by user id.

CaseQueueOut.title: CaseQueueOut
CaseQueueOut.description: One row of the moderator queue (W6): no names or ids of the people involved.

CommunityOut.title: CommunityOut
CommunityOut.description: Indirect evidence (FR-T-04): it can support a request but never makes it SUFFICIENT.

CounterOfferIn.title: CounterOfferIn
CounterOfferIn.description: Other dates the lender offers (ADR-0015); same date rules as a request.

DecisionIn.title: DecisionIn
DecisionIn.description: UC-I4: the decision, its mandatory reason (FR-T-11), and what it needs.

DisputeIn.title: DisputeIn
DisputeIn.description: UC-B12 step 2: a reason from the fixed list and a description (photos come with C2 uploads).

DisputeTrailOut.title: DisputeTrailOut
DisputeTrailOut.description: UC-D6 evidence trail: the case, the loan, both sides' reports, the history, the assessment.

ExtensionIn.title: ExtensionIn
ExtensionIn.description: The borrower asks to return later: the new last day, exclusive like `end_date` of a request.

FixIn.title: FixIn
FixIn.description:
One-time device fix. Evaluated in memory by the LocalityVerifier and then dropped: it is
never stored, logged or returned (NFR-PR-01, sequence (d)).

InformationRequestOut.title: InformationRequestOut
InformationRequestOut.description: The moderator's latest question (sequence (g)); `to` is BORROWER, LENDER or BOTH.

InvitationOut.title: InvitationOut
InvitationOut.description: The code is shown once; only its hash is stored.

ItemOut.title: ItemOut
ItemOut.description: GET /items/{id}: the listing plus the dates already booked (B4, B5 step 1).

ItemPhotoForm.title: ItemPhotoForm
ItemPhotoForm.description: Multipart body: the file and nothing else. Unknown fields are refused (TC-60).

JobRunIn.title: JobRunIn
JobRunIn.description: `as_of` is honoured only when the API runs with DEMO_CLOCK on (ADR-0012 point 5).

ListingOut.title: ListingOut
ListingOut.description: A listing as its owner or a member sees it. The owner is named, never identified by id.

LocalityOut.title: LocalityOut
LocalityOut.description: The outcome in neutral words; never a rejection (FR-A-08).

ModeratorCaseOut.title: ModeratorCaseOut
ModeratorCaseOut.description: UC-D6 evidence trail for the moderator (W7).

NotificationOut.title: NotificationOut
NotificationOut.description: One in-app notification. The app writes the sentence from `type` and `payload`.

PathOut.title: PathOut
PathOut.description: One community path from the lender to the borrower, by display name only (no user ids).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Exclusive end: the item is returned by this date

ReviewIn.title: ReviewIn
ReviewIn.description: One rating per dimension of the other party's role (config `reviews_d1.dimensions`).

ReviewOut.title: ReviewOut
ReviewOut.description: The review was stored. Flags are not returned to the reviewer (sequence (f)).

SearchResultOut.title: SearchResultOut
SearchResultOut.description:
One result: the listing, whether it is in the member's community, and a reason line in
plain words. Scores are kept for evaluation and never returned (FR-S-01, NFR-U-01).

StatementOut.title: StatementOut
StatementOut.description: A party's response on a case. The author is named and given by role, never by id.
